208146720.description: Stamina never fully drains while sprinting. Any action or damage cancels the skill.  Recovery time scales with duration.
208146720.name: Sprinting On Fumes

332526965.description: Increases the duration of the high speed at the start of a sprint.
332526965.name: Swift Start

515215214.description: Lets you perform a melee attack using your equipped weapon.
515215214.name: Weapon Bash

548030945.description: Mines and explosive deployables can be defused when in close proximity
548030945.name: Minesweeper

669728748.description: Your stamina regeneration is less affected by being over-encumbered.
669728748.name: Stubborn Mule

737221938.description: You make less noise when looting.
737221938.name: Silent Scavenger

905837212.description: Unlocks additional items to field craft.
905837212.name: Traveling Tinkerer

1521617800.description: While downed, you take less damage.

1818452723.name: Speedy Mule

1895741136.description: You make less noise when breaching.
